title: Design System: Tessmora Architecture Reading Surface

display.purpose: Tessmora Sans 650, 40–64px fluid sizing; 36px at route widths of 600px or below and 28px at 320px or below.

headline.purpose: Tessmora Sans 650, 32–48px fluid sizing; 32px on small screens.

section.purpose: Tessmora Sans 650 at 26px/1.5; 24px at route widths of 600px or below.

subhead.purpose: 20px Tessmora Sans for steps and supporting headings; 18px on small screens.

body.purpose: Tessmora Sans 400 at 18px/1.85; 17px at route widths of 600px or below.

prose.purpose: Visible explanations normally bounded at 76ch with 18px paragraph spacing.

support.purpose: 16px explanations and tables, including narrow layouts.

quote.purpose: Tessmora Serif for execution questions, specimen fragments and cited examples; never the primary heading face.

small.purpose: 13px captions, topic indices and secondary outline text.

source.purpose: Monospace for actual paths, fields, collection names and compact data.

motion.name: topic-entry
motion.purpose: One visible 5px vertical movement; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: overview-arrow
motion.purpose: 4px arrow response on the overview action.

motion.name: section-jump
motion.purpose: Focus and scroll to a section selected in the inline wide-screen outline.

components.name: Parsing modality
components.description: Five modality tabs expose the selected specimen and processing details. At parsing-container widths of 560px or below, all five remain visible as icon-over-label choices with a 64px minimum height; the grid has five columns above 240px and three at 240px or below. Labels are 16px, then 14px at 340px. Documents displays as Docs narrowly while retaining the full accessible name.
components.css: .ds-parsing{container:ds-parsing/inline-size;font-family:'Tessmora Sans','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-material-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:6px;background:var(--book-canvas,#f7f4fa);border-radius:12px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--book-line,#e6e0ed) transparent}.ds-material{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;min-height:49px;padding:10px 18px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72);font-size:16px;transition:color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-material:hover{color:var(--book-accent,#6948a5)}.ds-material[aria-selected='true']{background:var(--book-accent,#6948a5);color:var(--book-paper,#fffefd);font-weight:600}.ds-material-short{display:none}.ds-material:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--book-accent,#6948a5);outline-offset:-3px}@container ds-parsing (max-width:560px){.ds-material-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;overflow:visible}.ds-material{flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:64px;gap:5px;padding:7px 2px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.3}.ds-material-full{display:none}.ds-material-short{display:inline}}@container ds-parsing (max-width:340px){.ds-material{font-size:14px}.ds-material svg{width:15px}}@container ds-parsing (max-width:240px){.ds-material-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-material{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-table-wrap{container:reading-table / inline-size;max-width:100%;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--book-accent,#6948a5) var(--book-tint,#f0eafa)}.ds-table-wrap:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--book-accent,#6948a5);outline-offset:4px}.ds-table{width:100%;min-width:340px;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;text-align:left;font:16px/1.75 "Tessmora Sans","PingFang SC",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-table caption{text-align:left;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72);font-size:14px;padding-bottom:14px}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{padding:16px 20px 16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--book-line,#e6e0ed);vertical-align:top}.ds-table thead th{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72)}.ds-table tbody th{color:var(--book-ink,#292437);font-weight:600}.ds-table td{color:var(--book-muted,#655f72)}@container reading-table (max-width:680px){.ds-table{display:block;min-width:0;width:100%}.ds-table caption{display:block}.ds-table thead{display:none}.ds-table tbody{display:block}.ds-table tr{display:block;padding-block:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--book-line,#e6e0ed)}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{display:block;position:static;width:auto;min-width:0;border:0;padding:0}.ds-table tbody th{margin-bottom:14px;font-size:16px}.ds-table tbody td{margin-top:14px;font-size:16px}.ds-table td::before{content:attr(data-label);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--book-accent,#6948a5);font-size:14px;font-weight:500}}

components.name: Structural explanation figure
components.description: Mint originals and lilac indexes are joined by shared source identity. Runtime reuses tinted responsibility groups. The separate PathFigure retains crisp SVG execution geometry; retrieval perspectives use transparent raster illustrations. Captions distinguish illustrations from observations.
components.css: .ds-mechanism{margin:24px 0 34px;color:var(--book-ink,#292437);font:16px/1.8 'Tessmora Sans','PingFang SC',sans-serif;container:ds-mechanism/inline-size}.ds-mechanism>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:stretch}.ds-mechanism section{min-width:0;padding:24px;border-radius:16px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--book-teal,#356f64) 13%,var(--book-paper,#fffefd))}.ds-mechanism section:last-child{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--book-accent,#6948a5) 13%,var(--book-paper,#fffefd))}.ds-mechanism strong{font-size:20px;font-weight:650;color:var(--book-teal,#356f64)}.ds-mechanism section:last-child strong{color:var(--book-accent,#6948a5)}.ds-mechanism p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72)}.ds-mechanism>div>span{align-self:center;font:14px/1.8 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-mechanism figcaption{padding:13px 0;font-size:16px;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72)}@container ds-mechanism (max-width:660px){.ds-mechanism>div{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

components.name: Retrieval perspective illustrations
components.description: Three transparent images explain retrieval perspectives: a violet semantic lens, mint matching terms, and distinct image/audio markers. They sit in 3:2 frames on 9% accent fields, with a 280px wide-layout height cap. Localized alt text and a shared conceptual caption preserve the distinction between retrieval candidates and verified answer support. PathFigure remains unchanged.
components.css: .ds-retrieval{container:ds-retrieval/inline-size;margin:0;color:var(--book-ink,#292437);font-family:'Tessmora Sans','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-retrieval-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px;margin:24px 0 22px}.ds-retrieval-item{--ds-art-color:var(--book-accent,#6948a5);min-width:0}.ds-retrieval-item[data-art='lexical']{--ds-art-color:var(--book-teal,#356f64)}.ds-retrieval-item[data-art='media']{--ds-art-color:var(--rv-apricot,#955d34)}.ds-retrieval-frame{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;max-height:280px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ds-art-color) 9%,var(--book-paper,#fffefd))}.ds-retrieval-frame img{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;object-fit:contain;padding:10px}.ds-retrieval-copy{padding-top:16px}.ds-retrieval-copy h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;margin:5px 0 8px}.ds-retrieval-copy>span{display:block;color:var(--ds-art-color);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 7px}.ds-retrieval-copy p{margin:0;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72);font-size:16px;line-height:1.9}.ds-retrieval>figcaption{border-top:1px solid var(--book-line,#e6e0ed);padding:13px 0 15px;color:var(--book-muted,#655f72);font-size:16px;line-height:1.9}@container ds-retrieval (max-width:540px){.ds-retrieval-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;margin-block:18px}.ds-retrieval-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(100px,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);align-items:center;gap:20px}.ds-retrieval-frame{min-width:0;max-height:none}.ds-retrieval-copy{padding-top:0}.ds-retrieval-copy h3{margin-block:3px 6px}.ds-retrieval-copy p{line-height:1.8}}@container ds-retrieval (max-width:390px){.ds-retrieval-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}.ds-retrieval-frame{max-height:240px}.ds-retrieval-copy{padding-top:16px}.ds-retrieval-copy>span{margin-top:4px}}

narrative.northStar: 以清晰的阅读路径与图文层次，讲清真实的设计与实现
narrative.overview:
This source snapshot records the focused `/architecture` surface on 2026-10-23. Tessmora presents an overview and seven substantive topics: design principles, parsing, storage, retrieval, execution paths, answers and citations, and runtime boundaries. Technical explanations, examples, tradeoffs and source links stay visible for the selected topic; only the retained reference appendices are folded.

The architecture surface remains inside the original application shell, as explicitly requested by the user. The conversation sidebar retains its brand, workspace navigation and global language/theme controls. The page adds only a “Design & implementation” header with GitHub, topic navigation and the reading area. Warm near-white paper, violet openings and purposeful diagram colors support the content. This is a route-specific design, not a product-wide restyle.
keyCharacteristics: The original conversation sidebar remains visible; the architecture header contains only its subject and GitHub.
An eight-column horizontal topic strip with an inline section outline at route widths above 1100px; previous/select/next navigation replaces it at 1100px and below.
Self-hosted Sans 650 headings, 18px body text and 16px supporting prose; Serif is reserved for quoted and example material.
The retained sculpture and transparent illustrations sit in tinted openings; storage/runtime diagrams and three retrieval illustrations use color to distinguish their subjects.
One topic at a time, URL-based navigation, normal-flow article pagination, coordinated themes and Chinese/English copy.

rules.name: The Explanation First Rule
rules.body: State the choice, show its mechanism and limits, and connect the explanation to a concrete example, diagram or source.

dos: **Do** preserve the original conversation sidebar and use horizontal topics or the compact selector according to the available architecture width.
**Do** keep technical depth, source links and illustrative boundaries visible in the selected topic.
**Do** preserve the artwork, font licenses and asset provenance recorded in docs/architecture-visual-assets.md and docs/architecture-typography-assets.md.
**Do** use color to clarify storage, process and retrieval relationships while keeping labels explicit.
**Do** verify both languages, both themes, narrow layouts, keyboard focus and reduced motion after UI changes.
donts: **Don't** remove the original conversation sidebar or duplicate its logo, workspace-return, language and theme controls inside the architecture header.
**Don't** replace substantive explanations with slogans or a repeated grid of generic cards.
**Don't** pin article pagination over the content, hide the retained mobile artwork or continuously animate illustrations.
**Don't** present conceptual diagrams, example citations or execution choices as live backend calls or measured performance.
